contracts.claim: documents.create writes a course document with one concept per chapter; documents.build compiles it with Tectonic and the PDF shows the six labelled blocks and every chapter.

On a clean document every outcome check passes from the produced files: no TeX errors, no undefined references, no overfull box over 1 pt, Inter embedded, blocks in order with tags, page count within the limit.
A document with blocks out of order, an untagged concept, an undefined reference and an overfull line still compiles but fails the blocks, references and overfull checks, each naming the fault.
The sheet variant builds from the same source, prints method and reflex and drops traps and practice.
documents.render writes the requested page as a non-blank PNG under D:/NeyviaRuns/docs.
Without an attached LAYA judge documents.glance reports not available and never passes.
The five documents tools are workspace tools and the toolchain (Tectonic binary and bundled Inter) is present.

frontier: The LAYA page glance is pluggable and reports not available until attached; it never counts as a pass.
